711   // The pc_mux signals probe the MUX in the IF stage to extract information about events in the WB stage.
712   // These signals are therefore used both in the WB stage to see effects of the executed instruction (e.g. rvfi_trap), and
713   // in the IF stage to see the reason for executing the instruction (e.g. rvfi_intr).
714   assign pc_mux_interrupt       = (ctrl_fsm_i.pc_mux == PC_TRAP_IRQ);
715   assign pc_mux_nmi             = (ctrl_fsm_i.pc_mux == PC_TRAP_NMI);
716   assign pc_mux_debug           = (ctrl_fsm_i.pc_mux == PC_TRAP_DBD);
717   assign pc_mux_exception       = (ctrl_fsm_i.pc_mux == PC_TRAP_EXC) || (ctrl_fsm_i.pc_mux == PC_TRAP_DBE) ;
718   assign pc_mux_dret            = (ctrl_fsm_i.pc_mux == PC_DRET);

731   // Set rvfi_trap for instructions causing exception or debug entry.
732   rvfi_trap_t  rvfi_trap_next;
733 
734   always_comb begin
735     rvfi_trap_next = '0;
736 
737     if (pc_mux_debug) begin
738       // All debug entries will set pc_mux_debug but only synchronous debug entries will set wb_valid (and in turn rvfi_valid)
739       // as asynchronous entries will kill the WB stage whereas synchronous entries will not.
740       // Indicate that the trap is a synchronous trap into debug mode
741       rvfi_trap_next.debug       = 1'b1;
742       // Special case for debug entry from debug mode caused by EBREAK as it is not captured by ctrl_fsm_i.debug_cause
743       rvfi_trap_next.debug_cause = (ebreak_in_wb_i && debug_mode_q_i) ? DBG_CAUSE_EBREAK : ctrl_fsm_i.debug_cause;
744     end
745 
746     if (pc_mux_exception) begin
747       // Indicate synchronous (non-debug entry) trap
748       rvfi_trap_next.exception       = 1'b1;
749       rvfi_trap_next.exception_cause = ctrl_fsm_i.csr_cause.exception_code[5:0]; // All synchronous exceptions fit in lower 6 bits
750 
751       // Separate exception causes with the same ecseption cause code
752       case (ctrl_fsm_i.csr_cause.exception_code)
753         EXC_CAUSE_INSTR_FAULT : begin
754           rvfi_trap_next.cause_type = instr_pmp_err[STAGE_WB] ? 2'h1 : 2'h0;
755         end
756         EXC_CAUSE_BREAKPOINT : begin
757           // Todo: Add support for trigger match exceptions when implemented in rtl
758         end
759         EXC_CAUSE_LOAD_FAULT : begin
760           rvfi_trap_next.cause_type = mem_err[STAGE_WB];
761         end
762         EXC_CAUSE_STORE_FAULT : begin
763           rvfi_trap_next.cause_type = mem_err[STAGE_WB];
764         end
765         default : begin
766           // rvfi_trap_next.cause_type is only set for exception codes that can have multiple causes
767         end
768       endcase // case (ctrl_fsm_i.csr_cause.exception_code)
769 
770     end
771 
772     if (pending_single_step_i && single_step_allowed_i) begin
773       // The timing of the single step debug entry does not allow using pc_mux for detection
774       rvfi_trap_next.debug       = 1'b1;
775       rvfi_trap_next.debug_cause = DBG_CAUSE_STEP;
776 
777       // In the case of an exception in WB and pending single step, both the exception and the debug flag will be set
778     end
779 
780     // Set trap bit if there is an exception or debug entry
781     rvfi_trap_next.trap = rvfi_trap_next.exception || rvfi_trap_next.debug;
